digest.component_or_area: graph resolver and link dependency logic
propositions: rebar link can silently record a different edge than requested when resolving cross-subtree dependencies, and can produce edges where a ticket blocks its own ancestor or descendant

The blocking-link resolver incorrectly decides comparability from ticket TYPE_TIER instead of structural position in the parent hierarchy, causing type-mismatched siblings to be escalated when they should form direct dependencies
Ancestor-blocking edges distort ready, next-batch, and parent-first claim cascade, causing parallel agents to receive incorrect work orders
Existing edges written under the type-tier rule must be detected and repaired store-wide in a single pass without breaking the escalation contract
The resolver must be rewritten to compute comparability from nearest common ancestor alone, with an invariant that prevents any blocking edge between a ticket and its own ancestor or descendant
